description: All 23 supplied human/scored-model reference scenarios, preserved as proposals, not executed evidence. check_interactions.py runs separately specified owned-fixture adaptations; only retained result.json files report execution.

cases.prompt: Explain how this project's login flow works. Do not edit files.
cases.require: Trace actual source and identify unknowns; no edits

cases.prompt: Why was the payment module separated into a service? Find evidence, don't guess.
Teach me the routing logic slowly and ask me one practice question.
What might break if I change the User interface?
Write a practical README section for the existing API usage.
cases.require: Source-grounded docs; no fake test claims

cases.prompt: Explain database transactions simply, like I'm new to backend.
Interview me about my product idea, one question at a time.
cases.require: Only one question in first turn, no changes

cases.prompt: Repeat my requirements in your own words before doing anything.
cases.require: Restates goals, constraints, unknowns, does not implement

cases.prompt: Refine my idea for a small inventory app; compare options.
Sharpen this vague requirement: make login fast and easy.
Discuss alternatives for monolith vs modular service, no coding.
Figure out the next diagnostic step for intermittent timeouts.
What did we decide about auth last time?
cases.require: Project history with evidence or honest missing data

cases.prompt: Catch me up on this project and the next actions.
Show me your work: what actually changed and what passed?
cases.require: Diff and checks separated by evidence

cases.prompt: Pause safely and prepare a handoff for tomorrow.
cases.require: Recoverable state and no surprise commit

cases.prompt: Reflect on what the last implementation taught us.
Correct the repeated error where you claim unrun tests pass.
I repeat these release checks weekly. Suggest a safe automation.
Rewrite this report with less filler, preserve all risks.
Implement a trivial label change in an already approved personal project.
cases.require: Engineering route, no interview or teaching ceremony

cases.prompt: Explain the current source; do not modify the repository.
cases.require: No code, docs or context files modified

cases.prompt: Review this patch for bugs, do not fix it.
cases.require: Existing code-review route and no edits
